original:
ईशा वास्यमिदं सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत्।
तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम्॥
transliteration:
īśā vāsyamidaṃ sarvaṃ yatkiñca jagatyāṃ jagat |
tena tyaktena bhuñjīthā mā gṛdhaḥ kasyasviddhanam ||

layers.author: siva
layers.content: All this, whatsoever moves in this universe, including the universe, itself moving, is indwelled or enveloped or clothed by the Lord. That renounced, thou shouldst enjoy. Covet not anybody's wealth.
